Exercise: Cable Deadlifts

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- knee_flexion
- hip_extension

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- forearms
- glutes
- hamstrings
- lower back

Equipment:

- cable

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- improve_hip_and_spinal_health
- strengthen_the_lower_body_and_core

Contraindications:

- Lower back issues
- Recent knee surgery

Exercise Variations:

- name: Single-Arm Cable Deadlifts, equipment: cable
- name: Romanian Deadlifts, equipment: barbell or cable

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Barbell Deadlifts, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Move the cables to the bottom of the towers and select an appropriate weight. Stand directly in between the uprights.
- To begin, squat down be flexing your hips and knees until you can reach the handles.
- After grasping them, begin your ascent. Driving through your heels extend your hips and knees keeping your hands hanging at your side. Keep your head and chest up throughout the movement.
- After reaching a full standing position, Return to the starting position and repeat.
